values.binNote: IreliaQ#MinionDamage = BaseDamage[rank] + byLevelL[...] + 0.8xad; the wiki's 'bonus' minion damage (pplevel 50 to 237) corresponds only to the inline byLevelL[...] term of this calculation, which has no separate named Spell.DataValue in the sheet. The BaseDamage[rank] and 0.8xad terms of this same calculation are already stated by q_1 (the base Physical Damage to champions applies to minions too, plus this bonus).

values.meaning: reduced cooldown on collision with a marked target
values.quote: {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced to {{fd|0.2}} seconds upon collision of targets {{as|marked|buzzword}}
values.binNote: No Spell.DataValue or calculation in the sheet corresponds to this 0.2-second reduced-cooldown-on-mark-consumption effect; it appears to be tooltip/behavior-only, not represented in the provided bin excerpt.

mechanics.claim: Dealing the damage applies on-hit effects.
If the target dies during the dash, the cooldown is fully reset.
mechanics.quote: If this attack kills the target, the cooldown is {{sti|ah|reset}}.

mechanics.claim: Whenever a mark is consumed on collision, the cooldown is reduced to 0.2 seconds rather than fully reset.
mechanics.quote: is reduced to {{fd|0.2}} seconds upon collision of targets {{as|marked|buzzword}} as ''Unsteady''

mechanics.claim: The damage counts as both basic damage and spell damage, triggering spell-based effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Bladesurge'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Damage is dealt on collision or at dash completion, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: deals its damage and consumes {{as|marks|buzzword}} when '''Irelia''' collides with the target, or at the end of the dash if the target moves away

mechanics.claim: No damage is dealt if the dash is interrupted before collision.
mechanics.quote: ''Bladesurge'' will not deal damage if the {{tip|dash}} is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} beforehand.

mechanics.claim: Irelia automatically auto-attacks the target after the dash completes.
mechanics.quote: '''Irelia''' will automatically be ordered to [[Basic attack#Acquisition|acquire]] and attack ''Bladesurge's'' target as soon as the dash completes.
